UNCA has long been underfunded but things seem to have taken a turn for the worse around 2012. Since 2015, several committees, task forces, and other groups have studied the problem and written reports with a particular interest on how it relates to faculty/staff compensation. As a member of Faculty Senate during part of that time who also works with data, I became involved with some of those groups. Since I was recently reappointed to the standing committee on compensation, I thought it might be a good time to gather some of that old material in one place and to start to put some new material together.

## Past reports 

Ordered chronologically by release date.

0. [Task Force on Faculty Salary and Equity](./documents/SalaryAndEquityReportJan2018.pdf) Jan 2018  
   <div class="note-comments">
   
    This $\text{zero}^{\text{th}}$ report predates my participation and is a bit different from the remaining documents in that it is not primarily motivated by concern with the level of compensation at UNCA. It's more concerned with equity between and within departments and with procedures for maintaining fairness moving forward. The report does note, however, that "substantive salary increases had not been available for several years".
